css: .trace-report{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#111;font-size:9px}.trace-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;border-bottom:3px solid #111;padding-bottom:7px}.trace-header h1{font-size:19px;margin:0}.trace-header p{margin:3px 0}.trace-code{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;border:2px solid #111;padding:6px 10px}.summary{margin-top:10px}.summary th{width:14%;background:#eee}.summary td{width:36%}h2{font-size:12px;margin:14px 0 5px;border-bottom:1px solid #555;padding-bottom:3px}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;page-break-inside:auto}th,td{border:1px solid #777;padding:4px;vertical-align:top}thead{display:table-header-group}tr{page-break-inside:avoid}.two-col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.unit{border:1px solid #777;border-left:4px solid #777;padding:5px;margin-bottom:4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.unit.upstream{border-left-color:#e87519}.unit.downstream{border-left-color:#249c45}.muted{color:#666}.warning{border:1px solid #c77b00;background:#fff4d6;padding:7px}.footer{margin-top:12px;padding-top:5px;border-top:1px solid #777;color:#555;font-size:8px}@media print{@page{size:A4 portrait;margin:10mm}}
